tokens.name: prussian-blue
tokens.usage: Core: deepest navy. Text on every light surface and pastel (13:1 or more); the page ground in dark.

tokens.name: stormy-teal
tokens.usage: Core: primary teal. Text and links on light surfaces and pastels (5:1 or more). On dark grounds use `brand`; this teal is 2.7:1 on `prussian-blue`, fills only.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Core: the warm accent. Fills, highlights and the key chart series. 7.3:1 on `prussian-blue`; on light grounds it is only 2.3:1, so never text there and give gold marks a label.

tokens.name: copperwood
tokens.usage: Core: deep warm copper, gold's darker sibling. Fills, marks and chart series on light grounds (3.7:1 on `neutral-50`); never body text. On dark grounds it is 4.25:1 on `prussian-blue`. Keep it apart from `gold` in charts: the two differ mainly in lightness (1.7:1). The warning/caution callout edge.

tokens.name: copper-deep
tokens.usage: Gold's text partner on light grounds: 6.1:1 on `neutral-50`, 5:1 or more on every pastel. Derived.

tokens.name: frosted-mint
tokens.usage: Pastel: pale mint. Not used on the website at present; available for soft fills and table bands on light grounds.

tokens.name: muted-teal
tokens.usage: Quiet sage. Links and buttons in dark (7.0:1 on `prussian-blue`), the tip callout edge in both themes, and a calm chart color. Never text on light grounds (2.3:1).

tokens.name: neutral-50
tokens.usage: Neutral tinted with prussian blue. The light page ground.

tokens.name: neutral-100
tokens.usage: Neutral. Code blocks and table headers in light; primary text in dark.

tokens.name: neutral-200
tokens.usage: Neutral. Zebra rows, hover fills in light.

tokens.name: neutral-300
tokens.usage: Neutral. Thin borders and dividers in light; secondary text in dark.

tokens.name: neutral-400
tokens.usage: Neutral. Disabled marks, de-emphasized chart series; control edges in dark (3:1 or more on dark surfaces).

tokens.name: neutral-500
tokens.usage: Neutral. Control edges and placeholders on light grounds (4.1:1 on `neutral-50`: not for body text).

tokens.name: neutral-600
tokens.usage: Neutral. Secondary text on light grounds (6.5:1 on `neutral-50`).

tokens.name: neutral-700
tokens.usage: Neutral. Strong secondary text on light grounds (9.5:1 on `neutral-50`).

tokens.name: neutral-800
tokens.usage: Neutral. Near-ink text, dark chart labels (13:1 or more on `neutral-50`).

tokens.name: teal-50
tokens.usage: Pastel: header text and icons (on `stormy-teal`, 5.7:1), subject tags, table row stripes and button text in light.

tokens.name: teal-100
tokens.usage: Pastel: stronger teal tint for selected rows and tags.

tokens.name: gold-50
tokens.usage: Pastel: callout background for the key finding; `copper-deep` or `prussian-blue` text on it.

tokens.name: gold-100
tokens.usage: Pastel: client tag background and text selection in light; `copper-deep` text on it (5:1).

tokens.name: navy-50
tokens.usage: Pastel: tool tags, note callouts and blockquotes in light; `prussian-blue` text on it.

tokens.name: navy-100
tokens.usage: Pastel: stronger navy tint for selected states and tags.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and inputs on `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, table headers and code blocks below `surface`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` (12:1 or more in both themes). Dark uses `neutral-100`, not mint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and captions on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` (4.5:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Links, active states, primary buttons and chart series 1. Text on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` in both themes.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `brand` fill.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one thing to look at: the key chart series, a highlight, an accent button. Fills only. On light surfaces gold is 2.3:1, so a gold mark carries a label or sits on `prussian-blue`.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Gold-family text: on light surfaces and pastels in light; on `surface` and `surface-raised` in dark.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an `accent` fill (7.3:1).

tokens.name: callout
tokens.usage: Background of a key-finding callout; text in `ink`, label in `accent-text`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers only. Not for control edges.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control edges and any border that carries meaning, 3:1 or more on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` in both themes.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Solid 2px focus ring, 3:1 or more on every surface in its theme.

tokens.name: header-bg
tokens.usage: Site header background, teal in both themes.

tokens.name: header-text
tokens.usage: Header text and icons on `header-bg` (5.7:1).

tokens.name: header-text-hover
tokens.usage: Header links on hover (6.3:1 on `header-bg`).

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Text selection highlight; `ink` stays the text color in light, `prussian-blue` on gold in dark.

tokens.name: table-stripe
tokens.usage: Alternate table rows.

tokens.name: tag-client-bg
tokens.usage: Client tag fill.

tokens.name: tag-client-text
tokens.usage: Client tag text on `tag-client-bg`.

tokens.name: tag-subject-bg
tokens.usage: Subject tag fill (benchmarking, fire-ems).

tokens.name: tag-tool-bg
tokens.usage: Tool tag fill (R, SQL, Shiny).
